title: ProBuilder overlays, actions toolbar, scene info

sections.heading: ACTIONS OVERLAY
sections.content:
The ProBuilder Actions Overlay (`ProBuilderActionsOverlay`) is a SceneView overlay that exposes ProBuilder menu actions as an interactive UI panel or toolbar. It is registered via Unity overlay system attributes `[Overlay(typeof(SceneView), overlayId, k_DisplayName, minHeight = 150f, maxHeight = 500f, minWidth = 200f, maxWidth = 600f, defaultDisplay = false)]` and `[Icon("Packages/com.unity.probuilder/Editor Default Resources/Icons/EditableMesh/EditMeshContext.png")]`, and implements `Overlay`, `ICreateHorizontalToolbar`, and `ICreateVerticalToolbar`.

1. Action Button Element Architecture:
- Each button is an instance of `ProBuilderActionButton : VisualElement` loaded from the UXML template `"Packages/com.unity.probuilder/Editor/Overlays/UXML/ActionButton.uxml"` via `VisualTreeAsset s_ButtonAsset`.
- Visual hierarchy contains: `m_Button` (`Button`), `m_Label` (`Label`), `m_Color` (`VisualElement` named `"ActionColor"`), and `m_Icon` (`Image` named `"ActionIcon"`).
- Icon resolution order: `action.icon` -> `IconUtility.GetIcon("Tools/EditShape")` fallback.
- Clicking an action button executes `EditorAction.Start(new MenuActionSettings(action, HasPreview(action)))`, opening the settings overlay with live preview enabled for all actions except `DetachFaces` and `DuplicateFaces`.
- Visual grouping and color-coding: `m_Color.style.backgroundColor` is populated using `ToolbarGroupUtility.GetColor(m_Action.group)`:
  - `ToolbarGroup.Tool`: `Color(0.6666f, 0.4f, 0.2f, 1f)` (orange/brown)
  - `ToolbarGroup.Selection`: `Color(0.1411f, 0.4941f, 0.6392f, 1f)` (blue)
  - `ToolbarGroup.Object` and `ToolbarGroup.Entity`: `Color(0.4f, 0.6f, 0.1333f, 1f)` (green)
  - `ToolbarGroup.Geometry`: `Color(0.7333f, 0.1333f, 0.2f, 1f)` (red)
  - Default fallback: `Color.white`.

2. Display Modes and User Preferences:
- Persisted via `s_CurrentMode = new Pref<DisplayMode>("pb_overlay.displaymode", DisplayMode.Full, SettingsScope.User)`.
- `DisplayMode.Icon`: `m_Icon` displayed (`DisplayStyle.Flex`), `m_Label` hidden (`DisplayStyle.None`), `m_Grid.fixedItemWidth = 40f`.
- `DisplayMode.Text`: `m_Icon` hidden (`DisplayStyle.None`), `m_Label` displayed (`DisplayStyle.Flex`), `m_Grid.fixedItemWidth = fullWidth` (viewport width minus 10px clamped between 0f and 180f).
- `DisplayMode.Full`: both `m_Icon` and `m_Label` displayed (`DisplayStyle.Flex`), `m_Grid.fixedItemWidth = fullWidth`.
- Action filtering preferences:
  - `s_DisplayEditors = new Pref<bool>("pb_overlay.displayeditors", true, SettingsScope.User)`: controls display of `ToolbarGroup.Tool` editor launcher actions.
  - `s_DisplaySelection = new Pref<bool>("pb_overlay.displayselection", false, SettingsScope.User)`: controls display of `ToolbarGroup.Selection` selection actions.

3. Per-Edit-Mode Population Algorithm (`RefreshAvailableActions()`):
- Action collection is obtained via `EditorToolbarLoader.GetActions()`.
- Exclusions:
  - Blacklisted types in `k_ContextMenuBlacklist`: `ToggleHandleOrientation`, `ToggleDragRectMode`, `ToggleSelectBackFaces`, `NewBezierShape`.
  - Entity group actions: `action.group == ToolbarGroup.Entity`.
- Contextual visibility filtering:
  - Determines context state: `isGOContext = EditorToolManager.activeToolContext is GameObjectToolContext`.
  - Evaluates `action.hidden`, which tests `action.validSelectModes` against `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode` (`SelectMode.Vertex`, `SelectMode.Edge`, `SelectMode.Face`, `SelectMode.TextureFace`).
  - Applies contextual override: `hidden |= shouldDisplayAsEditor || (action.group == ToolbarGroup.Object) ? !isGOContext : isGOContext;`.
  - When in `GameObjectToolContext` (`isGOContext == true`), `ToolbarGroup.Object` actions (`MergeObjects`, `MirrorObjects`, `FlipObjectNormals`, `SubdivideObject`, `FreezeTransform`, `CenterPivot`, `ConformObjectNormals`, `TriangulateObject`, `GenerateUV2`, `ProBuilderize`, `Export`) are visible, while geometry actions are hidden.
  - When in `PositionToolContext` (`isGOContext == false`), object actions are hidden, and geometry actions matching the active `SelectMode` (`CollapseVertices`, `BevelEdges`, `ExtrudeFaces`, `CutToolAction`) are visible.
  - Populates `m_AvailableActions` list and sets button visibility (`style.display = DisplayStyle.Flex` or `DisplayStyle.None`).

4. Panel and Toolbar Presentation:
- In Panel layout (`CreatePanelContent()`): builds a `GridView` (`itemsSource = m_AvailableActions`, `MakeItem = () => new ProBuilderActionButton()`, `BindItem = (el, idx) => el.Bind(m_AvailableActions[idx])`). A `ContextualMenuManipulator(BuildContextMenu)` provides right-click toggles for Icon/Text/Full display modes and editor/selection visibility.
- In Toolbar layout (`CreateHorizontalToolbarContent()` / `CreateVerticalToolbarContent()`): builds an `OverlayToolbar`, assigns CSS classes `toolbarHorizontalMode` or `toolbarVerticalMode`, and adds all enabled action buttons.
- Event bindings: subscribes to `Selection.selectionChanged`, `ProBuilderEditor.selectModeChanged`, `ProBuilderEditor.selectionUpdated`, `ToolManager.activeContextChanged`, `GeometryChangedEvent`, `layoutChanged`, `floatingChanged`, and `dockingCompleted` to refresh and rebuild items.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, the actions overlay maps directly to an EditorPlugin bottom panel or a floating Control/PanelContainer placed inside the 3D viewport canvas overlay. DisplayMode can be implemented using Button with icon_alignment and expand_icon properties or an ItemList / GridContainer. Color coding uses a custom StyleBoxFlat with border or accent colors matching tool categories.

sections.heading: ACTION SETTINGS
sections.content:
Per-action option panels provide modal or floating parameter configuration for mesh operations (such as Extrude, Bevel, Connect, Subdivide, Offset, Mirror) with optional interactive live previews.

1. Invocation and Debouncing Flow:
- Invoked when a user triggers an action that supports settings, wrapping execution inside `MenuActionSettings : EditorAction`.
- Debounce protection: `s_CanTriggerNewAction` static flag ensures actions are invoked once per selection batch rather than per individual selected GameObject. Reset asynchronously via `EditorApplication.delayCall += () => { s_CanTriggerNewAction = true; };`.
- Executes `PreviewActionManager.DoAction(action, hasPreview)`.

2. PreviewActionManager Lifecycle and State Machine:
- `PreviewActionManager` is a singleton instance managing live preview execution and the active settings overlay.
- In `Init(MenuAction action, bool preview)`:
  - Stores `m_CurrentAction = action` and `m_HasPreview = preview`.
  - When `preview == true`, initiates preview recording via `UndoUtility.StartPreview()` and performs the initial operation `m_CurrentAction.PerformAction()`.
  - Instantiates `MenuActionSettingsOverlay` and attaches it to the viewport via `SceneView.AddOverlayToActiveView(m_Overlay)`.
  - Subscribes to editor state change events: `Selection.selectionChanged`, `ToolManager.activeContextChanged`, `ToolManager.activeToolChanged`, `ProBuilderEditor.selectionUpdated`, `ProBuilderEditor.selectModeChanged`. Any selection or tool transition automatically validates and commits the pending preview.

3. Overlay Structure (`MenuActionSettingsOverlay`):
- Displays title `PreviewActionManager.actionName` and tooltip `PreviewActionManager.actionTooltip`.
- Root container layout: `flexDirection = FlexDirection.Column`, fixed width `minWidth = maxWidth = 300`.
- Injects custom action parameter UI obtained from `m_CurrentAction.CreateSettingsContent()` via `PreviewActionManager.GetContent()`.
- Live preview toggle: when `PreviewActionManager.hasPreview` is true, appends a `Toggle("Live Preview")` bound to `s_AutoUpdatePreview` (`Pref<bool>("editor.autoUpdatePreview", false, SettingsScope.Project)`). When disabled, `delayedPreview` is true, suppressing continuous mesh recalculation on expensive selections.
- Confirmation footer row (`FlexDirection.Row`):
  - Confirm button (`"Confirm"`): triggers `PreviewActionManager.Validate()`, which invokes `Dispose()` and `UndoUtility.ExitAndValidatePreview()` (or `PerformAction()` if not running with preview).
  - Cancel button (`"Cancel"`): triggers `PreviewActionManager.Cancel()`, which invokes `Dispose()` and reverts state via `UndoUtility.UndoPreview()`.

4. Dynamic Preview Updates (`UpdatePreviewInternal()`):
- When action parameters change in the settings UI, `PreviewActionManager.UpdatePreview()` is called.
- Temporarily unregisters event listeners (`ProBuilderEditor.selectionUpdated -= OnSelectionUpdated; Selection.selectionChanged -= ObjectSelectionChanged;`) to prevent recursive refresh loops caused by undo/mesh rebuild events, executes `UndoUtility.StartPreview()` and `m_CurrentAction.PerformAction()`, and then re-registers listeners.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, per-action options can be presented as an EditorProperty inspector or an AcceptDialog / PopupPanel attached to the 3D viewport. Live preview operations clone the target ArrayMesh or operate on duplicate staging data, committing to the UndoRedo history only on confirmation, and reverting geometry when cancelled or when the active node selection changes.

sections.heading: SELECTION SETTINGS
sections.content:
ProBuilder selection settings control element picking behavior, transform gizmo orientation, drag selection geometry tests, and occluded element visibility. These settings are exposed via toolbar elements and persisted through `Pref<T>` settings.

1. Select Mode Button Strip (`SelectModeToolbar`):
- Registered as `[EditorToolbarElement("ProBuilder Settings/Select Mode")]` inheriting `VisualElement`.
- Instantiates three `SelectModeToggle : EditorToolbarToggle` buttons initialized with `SelectMode.Vertex` (`"Modes/Mode_Vertex"`), `SelectMode.Edge` (`"Modes/Mode_Edge"`), and `SelectMode.Face` (`"Modes/Mode_Face"`).
- Formatted as a cohesive segmented control using `EditorToolbarUtility.SetupChildrenAsButtonStrip(this)`.
- Mutual exclusivity and non-empty enforcement: `RegisterValueChangedCallback` sets `ProBuilderEditor.selectMode = m_Mode` when checked, and calls `SetValueWithoutNotify(true)` if unchecked, ensuring edit mode cannot be toggled off directly without selecting another mode.

2. Drag Rect Mode Toggle (`DragRectModeToggle`):
- Registered as `[EditorToolbarElement("ProBuilder Settings/Drag Rect Mode")]` inheriting `EditorToolbarToggle`.
- Backed by `ToggleDragRectMode : MenuAction` with icons `"Toolbar/DragSelect_Off"` (Intersect / Partial) and `"Toolbar/DragSelect_On"` (Complete).
- Values: `RectSelectMode.Partial` (default, selects elements intersecting the drag rectangle) and `RectSelectMode.Complete` (requires element vertices/edges/faces to be fully enclosed within the rectangle).
- Persistence: stored in `ProBuilderEditor.s_DragSelectRectMode = new Pref<RectSelectMode>("editor.dragSelectRectMode", RectSelectMode.Partial)`.
- Modifying the toggle updates `ProBuilderEditor.rectSelectMode`, setting `m_ScenePickerPreferences.rectSelectMode` and firing `ProBuilderEditor.rectSelectModeChanged`.
- Visible in Edge, Face, and TextureFace selection modes; hidden in Vertex mode via `validSelectModes = SelectMode.Edge | SelectMode.Face | SelectMode.TextureFace`.

3. Select Back Faces Toggle (`SelectBackFacesToggle`):
- Registered as `[EditorToolbarElement("ProBuilder Settings/Select Back Faces")]` inheriting `EditorToolbarToggle`.
- Backed by `ToggleSelectBackFaces : MenuAction` with icons `"Toolbar/Selection_SelectHidden-OFF"` and `"Toolbar/Selection_SelectHidden-ON"`.
- State determines backface culling during raycast and box picking: `true` enables selecting occluded/back-facing geometry (`CullingMode.None`), `false` culls backfaces (`CullingMode.Back`).
- Persistence: stored in `ProBuilderEditor.s_BackfaceSelectEnabled = new Pref<bool>("editor.backFaceSelectEnabled", false)`.
- Setting `ProBuilderEditor.backfaceSelectionEnabled` updates `m_ScenePickerPreferences.cullMode = value ? CullingMode.None : CullingMode.Back` and fires `ProBuilderEditor.backfaceSelectionEnabledChanged`.

4. Handle Orientation Dropdown (`HandleOrientationDropdown`):
- Registered as `[EditorToolbarElement("ProBuilder Settings/Handle Orientation")]` inheriting `EditorToolbarDropdown`.
- Backed by `ToggleHandleOrientation : MenuAction`.
- Supported orientations (`HandleOrientation` enum):
  - `HandleOrientation.World` (0): fixed world coordinate axes, icon `"ToolHandleGlobal"`.
  - `HandleOrientation.ActiveObject` (1): aligned with active GameObject transform rotation, icon `"ToolHandleLocal"`.
  - `HandleOrientation.ActiveElement` (2): aligned with normal/tangent space of selected vertex/edge/face, icon `"Packages/com.unity.probuilder/Editor Default Resources/Icons/Modes/ToolHandleElement.png"`.
- Persistence: stored in `VertexManipulationTool.s_HandleOrientation = new Pref<HandleOrientation>("editor.handleOrientation", HandleOrientation.World, SettingsScope.User)`.
- Clicking opens a `GenericMenu` via `menu.DropDown(worldBound)`. Setting `m_MenuAction.handleOrientation = handleOrientation` updates `VertexManipulationTool.handleOrientation`, notifies `VertexManipulationTool.handleOrientationChanged`, and invokes `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh(false)`.

5. X-Ray View Toggle (`ToggleXRay`):
- `ToggleXRay : MenuAction` has `hidden => true` (excluded from standard toolbar strip, accessible via menu shortcut `Alt+Shift+X` or preferences).
- Persistence: stored in `EditorHandleDrawing.s_XRayView = new Pref<bool>("graphics.xRayView", true, SettingsScope.User)`.
- Property `EditorHandleDrawing.xRay` toggles `s_XRayView.value` and triggers `SceneView.RepaintAll()`. When active, occluded vertices, edges, and faces are rendered in scene handle passes with depth comparison `CompareFunction.Greater` and dimmed tint `k_OccludedTint`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, selection settings correspond directly to 3D editor viewport toolbar buttons (e.g. Mode toggle buttons, Local/Global gizmo transform mode, Cull Backfaces checkbox). Persistence is achieved using EditorSettings.set_setting("probuilder/settings/...") and EditorSettings.get_setting(...).

sections.heading: SCENE INFORMATION
sections.content:
The Scene Information overlay (`SceneInformationOverlay : Overlay`) presents real-time geometric and selection metrics for selected ProBuilder meshes directly inside the SceneView.

1. Registration and Activation:
- Display title: `"ProBuilder Information"`.
- Controlled by user preference `ProBuilderEditor.s_ShowSceneInfo = new Pref<bool>("editor.showSceneInfo", false)` registered under `[UserSetting("General", "Show Scene Info", "Toggle the display of information about selected meshes in the Scene View.")]`.
- Dynamically added and removed from the active SceneView by `PositionToolContext.UpdateSceneInfoOverlay()` via `SceneView.AddOverlayToActiveView(m_SceneInfoOverlay)` and `SceneView.RemoveOverlayFromActiveView(m_SceneInfoOverlay)` when the ProBuilder tool context is active and `s_ShowSceneInfo` is enabled.

2. Statistics Metrics Displayed:
- The panel constructs a vertical list (`FlexDirection.Column`) containing 6 formatted rows separated by a 10px vertical spacer:
  - 1. Total Faces: `m_FaceCountLabel.text = MeshSelection.totalFaceCount.ToString()` — sum of `mesh.faceCount` across all selected ProBuilder meshes.
  - 2. Total Triangles: `m_TriCountLabel.text = MeshSelection.totalTriangleCountCompiled.ToString()` — compiled render primitive count calculated from `UnityEngine.ProBuilder.MeshUtility.GetPrimitiveCount(mesh.mesh)`.
  - 3. Total Vertices: `m_VertCountLabel.text = MeshSelection.totalCommonVertexCount + " (" + MeshSelection.totalVertexCountOptimized + ")"` — count of unique shared geometric vertices (`mesh.sharedVerticesInternal.Length`) followed in parentheses by total compiled/split vertex count (`mesh.mesh.vertexCount`).
  - Spacer: `VisualElement` with `style.height = 10`.
  - 4. Selected Faces: `m_SelectedFaceCountLabel.text = MeshSelection.selectedFaceCount.ToString()` — sum of `mesh.selectedFaceCount` across selected objects.
  - 5. Selected Edges: `m_SelectedEdgeCountLabel.text = MeshSelection.selectedEdgeCount.ToString()` — sum of `mesh.selectedEdgeCount` across selected objects.
  - 6. Selected Vertices: `m_SelectedVertCountLabel.text = MeshSelection.selectedSharedVertexCount + " (" + MeshSelection.selectedVertexCount + ")"` — count of selected unique shared vertex indices (`mesh.selectedSharedVerticesCount`) followed in parentheses by total selected split vertex indices (`mesh.selectedIndexesInternal.Length`).

3. Update Frequency and Event Triggers:
- Attached to panel event listeners (`OnAttachedToPanel`):
  - `ProBuilderEditor.selectionUpdated += OnSelectionUpdated` — updates whenever element selection (vertices, edges, faces) changes.
  - `MeshSelection.objectSelectionChanged += UpdateSceneInfo` — updates when GameObject selection changes in the scene hierarchy.
  - `ProBuilderMesh.versionChanged += OnMeshVersionChanged` — updates when mesh topology, vertex positions, or normals are modified.
- Also refreshed synchronously when `CreatePanelContent()` builds the visual tree.
- Backing calculation caching: `MeshSelection.CacheElementCounts()` evaluates a dirty flag `s_ElementCountsDirty`, which is invalidated by `objectSelectionChanged`, `selectionUpdated`, `EditorMeshUtility.meshOptimized`, and `PrefabUtility.prefabInstanceReverted`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, scene mesh statistics can be shown in a floating HUD overlay (Control / PanelContainer) in the 3D viewport canvas or in the status bar at the bottom of the editor. Vertex, triangle, and surface counts can be fetched from Mesh / ArrayMesh (mesh.get_surface_count(), mesh.surface_get_array_len()) and selection element arrays.

sections.heading: TOOL CONTEXTS
sections.content:
ProBuilder integrates into the Unity Editor as a custom tool context (`PositionToolContext` and `TextureToolContext`), providing standard transform tool overriding, context menu injection, SceneView GUI dispatching, and overlay lifecycle synchronization.

1. Custom Tool Context Registration:
- `PositionToolContext : EditorToolContext` is decorated with `[EditorToolContext("ProBuilder", typeof(ProBuilderMesh))]` and `[Icon("Packages/com.unity.probuilder/Editor Default Resources/Icons/EditableMesh/EditMeshContext.png")]`.
- When a GameObject with a `ProBuilderMesh` component is selected, Unity automatically activates the ProBuilder tool context in the SceneView context bar.
- `TextureToolContext : EditorToolContext` is defined for UV and texture manipulation.

2. Transform Tool Redirection (`GetEditorToolType(Tool tool)`):
- In `PositionToolContext`, standard transform tools are intercepted and replaced with ProBuilder custom element tools:
  - `Tool.Move` -> `typeof(ProbuilderMoveTool)`
  - `Tool.Rotate` -> `typeof(ProbuilderRotateTool)`
  - `Tool.Scale` -> `typeof(ProbuilderScaleTool)`
- In `TextureToolContext`, transform tools are mapped to texture element tools:
  - `Tool.Move` -> `typeof(TextureMoveTool)`
  - `Tool.Rotate` -> `typeof(TextureRotateTool)`
  - `Tool.Scale` -> `typeof(TextureScaleTool)`

3. Lifecycle and Overlay Coordination:
- `OnActivated()`:
  - Instantiates `m_Editor = new ProBuilderEditor()`.
  - Subscribes to `ProBuilderSettings.instance.afterSettingsSaved += UpdateSceneInfoOverlay`.
  - Invokes `UpdateSceneInfoOverlay()`, which creates and adds `SceneInformationOverlay` to the active SceneView if `ProBuilderEditor.s_ShowSceneInfo` is enabled.
  - Registers shortcut handling context: `ShortcutManager.RegisterContext(m_ShortcutContext ??= new ProBuilderShortcutContext())`, where `ProBuilderShortcutContext : IShortcutContext` is active when `EditorWindow.focusedWindow is SceneView && ProBuilderEditor.instance != null`.
- `OnWillBeDeactivated()`:
  - Disposes `m_Editor.Dispose()`.
  - Unsubscribes from settings events.
  - Removes `m_SceneInfoOverlay` from active SceneView: `SceneView.RemoveOverlayFromActiveView(m_SceneInfoOverlay)`.
  - Unregisters shortcut context: `ShortcutManager.UnregisterContext(m_ShortcutContext)`.
- `OnToolGUI(EditorWindow window)`: forwards SceneView GUI repaint and interaction events to `editor.OnSceneGUI(view)`.

4. Right-Click SceneView Context Menu Injection (`PopulateMenu(DropdownMenu menu)`):
- Injects standard selection commands: `"Edit/Select All"` -> `"Select/Select All"`, `"Edit/Deselect All"` -> `"Select/Deselect All"`, `"Edit/Invert Selection"` -> `"Select/Invert Selection"`.
- Iterates through `EditorToolbarLoader.GetActions()`, skipping blacklisted types (`k_ContextMenuBlacklist`) and groups (`ToolbarGroup.Entity`, `ToolbarGroup.Object`, `ToolbarGroup.Tool`).
- Inserts visual separators across group boundaries.
- Rebrands `ToolbarGroup.Selection` title to `"ProBuilder Select"`.
- Dispatches action execution: if `action.hasFileMenuEntry`, routes to file menu path; if `action.optionsEnabled`, triggers `EditorAction.Start(new MenuActionSettings(action, HasPreview(action)))`; otherwise executes `action.PerformAction()` directly.
- If non-ProBuilder `MeshFilter` components are selected alongside ProBuilder meshes, appends standard Mesh Filter context menu items.

5. Inspector CONTEXT Menu Items:
- Context menu entries on `ProBuilderMesh` component inspector (`[MenuItem("CONTEXT/ProBuilderMesh/...")]`):
  - Operations: `Conform Normals`, `Export`, `Triangulate`, `Center Pivot`, `Flip Normals`, `Subdivide Object`, `Mirror Objects`, `Merge Objects`, `Freeze Transform`, `Set Trigger`, `Set Collider`.
  - Debouncing latch: uses `s_ActionAlreadyTriggered` boolean flag and `EditorApplication.delayCall` to prevent multi-object selections from executing the action multiple times for a single user click.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, tool context activation corresponds to an EditorPlugin implementing _handles(Object *object) returning true when a target ProBuilder Mesh node is selected. Gizmo overrides map to EditorNode3DGizmoPlugin and _forward_3d_gui_input(Camera3D *camera, const Ref<InputEvent> &event). Context menus are injected into EditorInterface.get_editor_main_screen() or popup menus via add_custom_control_to_container.
